mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT TOP 100 FCY_0 AS Site FROM EXPLOIT.FACILITY WHERE MFGFLG_0 != 1 OR SALFLG_0 != 1 OR PURFLG_0 != 1 OR WRHFLG_0 != 1 ORDER BY FCY_0 DESC
mapper.sql:
SELECT AUTILIS.USR_0 AS UserCode, AUTILIS.NOMUSR_0 AS UserName, AUTILIS.ADDEML_0 AS Email, AUTILIS.ENAFLG_0 AS Enabled FROM EXPLOIT.AUTILIS AUTILIS WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( AUTILIS.USR_0 = #{User} OR UPPER(AUTILIS.NOMUSR_0) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{User}) + '%' OR UPPER(AUTILIS.ADDEML_0) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{User}) + '%' )

SELECT DISTINCT AUTILIS.USR_0 AS BuyerCode, AUTILIS.NOMUSR_0 AS BuyerName FROM EXPLOIT.AUTILIS AUTILIS WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( AUTILIS.USR_0 = #{Buyer} OR UPPER(AUTILIS.NOMUSR_0) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{Buyer}) + '%' )
mapper.select: ORDER BY BuyerName ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT AUTILIS.USR_0 AS LogisticsOperatorCode, AUTILIS.NOMUSR_0 AS LogisticsOperatorName FROM EXPLOIT.AUTILIS AUTILIS WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( AUTILIS.USR_0 = #{LogisticsOperator} OR UPPER(AUTILIS.NOMUSR_0) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{LogisticsOperator}) + '%' )
mapper.select: ORDER BY LogisticsOperatorName ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql:
SELECT SALESREP.REPNUM_0 AS RepresentativeCode, SALESREP.REPNAM_0 AS RepresentativeName FROM EXPLOIT.SALESREP SALESREP WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( SALESREP.REPNUM_0 LIKE #{Representative} + '%' OR UPPER(SALESREP.REPNAM_0) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{Representative}) + '%' )
mapper.select: ORDER BY RepresentativeName ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO FROM EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 WHERE UPPER(SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0) LIKE UPPER(#{OrderNO}) + '%'
ORDER BY SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
